selection_rule: Restrict the corrected China81 catalog to all nine 100-customer instances so the search process has publication-scale observation depth. Compute the five frozen input-only features, population z-score each feature within this nine-instance set, and choose the minimum Euclidean distance to the feature-wise median; break an exact tie by instance_id.
selection_boundary: The 100-customer size was fixed for process observability, not claimed to represent all 81 instances. Generality comes only from the complete 81-instance formal matrix. The selected instance appeared in an earlier development panel with a different seed, but no staged-v5 seed-1-to-10 result was read or used for this selection.

feature_definitions.demand_dispersion: population standard deviation of customer demand divided by mean demand
feature_definitions.time_window_tightness: mean customer time-window width divided by the 06:00--22:00 horizon
feature_definitions.ev_reachability: mean min(1, full-battery energy divided by corrected directed home-depot-to-customer EV energy at half payload)

trajectory_contract.source: actual online complete-model checkpoint observations plus the returned endpoint
trajectory_contract.display_seed_rule: For each algorithm, choose the seed whose final cost is closest to that algorithm's ten-seed mean; break an exact tie by smaller seed.
trajectory_contract.axes: same time(min)-cost(CNY) single-axis convention as Chen et al. (2025)
forbidden: changing the instance or seed after seeing curve shape
offline scoring of discarded candidates that the algorithm did not retain as online complete checkpoints
